jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Engineering & Manufacturing Systems (f/m/d)
jobs.description: TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Backend Engineer, Engineering & Manufacturing Systems to own the software behind our end-of-line testing. You own the service that orchestrates test plans across stations, talks to PLCs, scanners and measurement equipment, provisions every unit and records what was tested. Every product and variant we build passes through it, and when it stops, the line stops. This is not a classic application backend: your system sits between software, hardware and the shop floor. Your roadmap to make an impact Test orchestration: Own the service end to end: API, test plan engine, state machines for units, jobs and plans, persistence, events and deployment Shop floor integration: Integrate PLCs, station middleware, 3D scanners and measurement and calibration equipment through robust interfaces with clear timeouts, retries and error handling Iterative tests: Closed feedback loops between the test runtime and the station, such as calibration where the station controls timing and the service computes the next step Products and variants: Model products, variants, test plans and tolerances so that new products and process changes become configuration, not code Provisioning and records: Integrate PKI and ERP to provision every unit and produce signed, auditable test records Line reliability: Offline tolerance at the station, idempotent operations, safe deployments during production and fast incident response Testability: Clean architecture and emulators for stations and devices, so changes are proven before they reach the line Observability: Structured logging, metrics and tracing that show what is wrong on the line before operators notice On the floor: Work with production engineers, quality and station suppliers, and turn process changes into software quickly Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of backend engineering in production Expert Python: typing, asyncio, a modern web framework such as FastAPI, and pytest as a daily tool Strong grasp of software architecture: clean architecture, jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move. As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better. Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs. What you will do Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends. Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners. Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters. Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly. jobs.title: Head of IT and Security
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN US Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator. Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As our Head of IT & Security in Munich, you will own IT and security across all of our sites: reliable systems so our people can work quickly, protection for one of the most valuable bodies of fusion IP in Europe, and the evidence that our controls work. Get the full value from Google Workspace Enterprise, GCP and our security tools, and enforce device management, endpoint protection, SSO, MFA and access controls. Set physical security standards for site access, cameras, visitors, monitoring and escalation. Bring in specialist expertise early to assess site risks and verify controls through commissioning. Own the cyber configuration, identity integration and security logging of connected access-control and camera systems. Define and verify security controls for lab, test-data and operational technology systems, with clear handling of exceptions. Manage our IT and security partners, contracts, service levels and licences, and match spend to what we use and need. You have owned an ISMS and led ISO 27001 certification or a comparable security compliance programme. You have hands-on depth in Google Workspace, identity and device management, endpoint security, SIEM and networks, and can review a firewall rule or access policy yourself. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior SEM Manager</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3">We’re looking for a Senior SEM Manager to run Paid Search execution across our European launch markets, reporting to the Director of SEM. This is an execution role: you will spend most of your time in Google Ads and Google Merchant Center, not in strategy decks. The Director of SEM owns the overall Paid Search and app strategy. jobs.title: ISO 27001 Auditor
jobs.description: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor Calibre | Permanent, full-time | London office, five days a week About Calibre Calibre is building an AI-native certification body. Our platform helps auditors review evidence, document findings and prepare reports, giving them more time to test whether controls work in practice. Auditors retain responsibility for every finding. The role We’re hiring a Lead Auditor to deliver independent ISO/IEC 27001 certification audits, witness new auditors and help shape the tools our audit team uses. You’ll work with colleagues in certification, product and engineering to make the audit process clearer and easier to use. What you’ll do Lead Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits, as well as surveillance and recertification audits. Plan audit activities, select defensible samples and test whether information security controls operate in practice. Write evidence-based findings and reports, and follow up on nonconformities and corrective actions. Maintain audit files that stand up to review, protect impartiality and keep certification decisions independent of the audit team. Witness new auditors in practice, document what you observe and give clear feedback. Use Calibre’s platform in live audits and show the product team where changes would improve evidence review, reporting or quality checks. What we’re looking for A current ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor qualification and a recent audit log. Experience leading third-party ISO 27001 certification audits in a certification-body setting. Enough hands-on understanding of cloud and security infrastructure to assess evidence such as IAM policies, infrastructure configuration and audit logs. Clear writing and sound audit judgement. You can explain your conclusions to a client’s technical team and defend them in a review. Interest in using AI-assisted tools in audit work and the judgement to verify their output against the underlying evidence. How to apply Create your Auditor Passport and upload your CV. If you have your Lead Auditor certificate and audit log to hand, please include those too. Compensation: £60K – £75K • 0.1% • Base Salary £60K – £75K • 0.1% Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. The role You’ll own the full sales cycle, from finding and qualifying the right businesses through to negotiating and closing. You’ll sell to founders, CFOs and Heads of Payments, often replacing an incumbent provider they’ve used for years. That means a consultative, technical sale with 3–6 month cycles and multiple stakeholders. You’ll have a book of ICP leads to work from, but the best people here build their own pipeline too. You’ll report to a Sales Team Lead and have real autonomy over how you hit your number. What you’ll do Generate and qualify your own pipeline, alongside a book of ICP leads Run discovery to understand how a prospect’s money flows, then shape a solution around it Pitch and demo Ryft to C-suite and senior finance and product stakeholders Negotiate commercials (pricing, volumes, contract terms) and close Work with Solutions, Product, Onboarding and Risk so new clients go live smoothly Keep your CRM sharp and forecast accurately Feed what you hear in the market back into product and go-to-market as we enter new regions What we’re looking for 2+ years in a closing AE role, ideally selling payments, fintech or financial infrastructure B2B A track record of closing complex deals with 3+ month cycles and multiple decision-makers Evidence of building your own pipeline, not just working inbound Comfortable talking about interchange, acquiring, settlement and pricing models, or able to get there fast Commercially sharp: you understand margin, volume and how to structure a deal that works for both sides Disciplined CRM habits and accurate forecasting Nice to have Experience selling to marketplaces, platforms or SaaS businesses Experience displacing incumbent PSPs (Stripe, Adyen, Checkout.com , etc.) Exposure to European or US markets Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the team Hi, I'm Mariot, I lead Engineering here at Motorway. We're around 70 engineers across product teams, building the marketplace and all services around that handles hundreds of vehicle transactions every day. We care about delivering value to the business, getting the architecture engineering sound, keeping the production bar high, and being early and deliberate about the technology we adopt. We have been early adopters of GenAI for software engineering, we've built a reputation for that, and we'd like to keep earning it. AI is enabling us to deliver faster at a much higher quality software while easing the maintenance of our existing services. About the role We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set technical direction and evolve engineering practices across Motorway, reporting to the Director of Engineering. This is a broad role: your remit spans multiple product areas and every engineering specialties, and your decisions will shape what we build, what we buy, and what we retire. jobs.title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers on analysis and verification planning. Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline. 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Primary structure experience is a plus. Experience working in large, multi-person CAD assemblies, including top-down design, skeleton or master models, in-context references and configurations. Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging. Why NewOrbit Space?

jobs.title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France.  This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. In this role, you will:   Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform. Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform. Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows. Respond to functional and technical

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national.   Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.   PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.   Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.   Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conduct

You will work closely with specialists from R&D, electronics, and software development to define, evaluate, integrate, and validate the robotic system across the full product development process. You will also work continuously with our operations team so that system decisions meet product target costs, manufacturability, and quality standards as ONE TEAM. Your work makes our robots more nimble, robust, and user-friendly, and opens new ways to optimize system performance and capabilities. jobs.description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started. Our Mission For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry. The Fulfilment & Express Team The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world. About the Role As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS. Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code. CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk. jobs.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
jobs.description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-grow

jobs.title: HR-Stagiair(e)

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. About the role Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface. Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range. This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team. What You'll Build & Own On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end. Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe. Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions. Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it. AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship. What You Bring Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system. Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns. Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end. AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role. ✨ Why join us? 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance) 📈 Equity

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself. You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security. This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype. Build AI solutions yourself Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers. A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute. You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer - Data Platform (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? You’ll join Statista’s newly formed Data Platform team. We’re building a central platform that brings together data—from market statistics to consumer surveys—under consistent standards for quality, documentation, and access. This gives product teams and AI agents a trusted foundation to build new applications and features without duplicating data or setting up separate pipelines. Your role Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams Your profile 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas). Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema). Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers. Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD). Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar). Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API. Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style. Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture. Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise. We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs. Why This Role Matters Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions. Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines. Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts. Organizational Structure: The Four Domains You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas: Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements. Core Accountabilities 1. Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the role At Tandem Health, we’re building a clinician copilot that gives time back to care teams so clinicians can focus on patients. As a Senior Account Executive m/f/d, you’ll turn thoughtful research and crisp outreach into momentum by opening the right doors, surfacing real problems, and setting up conversations that change how care is delivered. You’ll help define our outbound voice and playbooks with a bias for speed to impact, craft that delights, and radical transparency. You’ll work closely with clinicians and product so every meeting speaks to real workflows and outcomes. As our European footprint expands, this role can grow into leadership as we scale the commercial team. What you will do Own a defined geographic territory and build strong, trusted relationships with healthcare professionals through consistent on-site presence. Lead the discovery, solution positioning, and objection handling. Understand practitioners’ workflows and tailor solutions that help them save time, reduce administrative burden, improve visibility, and enhance patient care. Collaborate closely with Marketing and Sales leadership to refine messaging, share field insights, and improve go-to-market playbooks. What you bring Initial experience in sales, business development, or customer-facing roles, ideally involving field prospecting, outbound activity, or direct client interaction. Strong motivation for sales and comfort working toward objectives, with the resilience to handle rejection and maintain momentum. Ability to manage a full sales cycle with guidance: from first contact and discovery to closing and onboarding. Interest in healthcare, digital products, or technology that improves professional workflows and has a positive societal impact. A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a strong desire to learn and grow within a scaling commercial team. Bilingual fluency in both German and English Bonus points Previous experience in field sales, door-to-door prospecting, or territory-based commercial roles. Experience selling to healthcare professionals (clinics, private practices, care providers) or working in regulated environments. Experience in digital products, SaaS, or technology that improves professional workflows. Location While we believe great ideas thrive through in-person collaboration, this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, with occasional travel to our Munich office. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition First interview with our Sales team member Second interview with our Country Director for Germany Working Day - Join us in the Munich office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Culture at Tandem At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often

As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular. While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI. Your new role In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order Engineering ’ group. BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard. The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work. How you’ll make an impact Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with. Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them. Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer. Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change. Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices. Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do. Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way. Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback. Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes. Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems. What will set you up for success Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects. Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write. Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point. Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems. You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place. AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further.  You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones. jobs.description: Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular. While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within the UK.* Your new role As Senior Security Engineer, you will help Olo reduce identified risks, respond to adversarial attacks while maintaining the up-time of our systems, and implement the right strategic risk mitigation measures to safeguard the data of our clients and their customers while supporting innovation. You will also provide white glove service and support to internal and external stakeholders by addressing security questions and support issues as needed, and by mentoring other engineers in how to best provide support.  Additionally, you will help in the identification and prioritisation of future project initiatives based on risk, and execute on cross-functional projects with a high degree of ownership and excellence, all while actively mentoring other team members and elevating the collective team’s capabilities and skill sets through peering and informal training. How you’ll make an impact Detection and incident response : Lead improvements to monitoring, alerting and incident response. Take part in the on-call rotation and manage escalated incidents thoroughly and professionally from start to resolution. Security tooling and automation : Run and optimise security tools such as SIEMs, EDR, cloud security posture (CNAPP) and vulnerability scanners. Build scripts and integrations that automate repetitive tasks and strengthen detection and response. Vulnerability and risk management : Carry out regular vulnerability assessments to find gaps in security controls and put fixes in place. Help shape how risks are identified, prioritised and mitigated. Secure architecture : Work with engineering, IT and other teams to define and build security best practices into systems and architecture, in line with company goals and industry standards. Project ownership : Own security projects end to end, prioritising work by risk and aligning it with team and company objectives. Processes and documentation : Write and maintain security processes, runbooks and procedures so the team is ready for both routine work and high-pressure incidents. Compliance and reporting : Support audits and certifications with accurate documentation. Give leadership clear data on incidents, vulnerabilities, project progress and key metrics. Mentoring and awareness : Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, run security awareness for technical teams (including secure coding and phishing / social-engineering risks), and keep up with emerging threats and tools. What will set you up for success 5+ years as a hands-on Security Engineer (or equivalent depth) who builds and implements controls, not just operates them. Comfortable switching between incident response, on-call triage, cloud work and engineering projects on a small team Hands-on incident response and threat investigation: comfortable working from raw evidence to build a timeline, judge severity and decide on containment. Practical application and edge security: writing and tuning WAF rules (e.g. Cloudflare managed rulesets, anomaly scoring, exceptions), bot management and a solid grasp of modern web protocols. Hands-on AWS security, including cloud hardening (IAM, network, workloads), and container / Kubernetes security (EKS or similar), with the ability to explain why each control matters. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. CesiumAstro’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems.   As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.   The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Designing and implementing software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment. Designing, developing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting system software. Reviewing code and system designs. Analyzing code for efficiency, stability, and scalability. Integrating and validating new product designs. Supporting software quality assurance and optimizing I/O performance. Providing post-production/in-orbit customer support. Interfacing with hardware design and development engineers. Assessing third-party and open-source software. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering. 4+ years of industry experience in software development. Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs. Experience with products for aerospace applications. Programming experience in C or C++. Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable). Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review. Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems. Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets. Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers. Experience in the design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK). CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. jobs.title: Principal, Revenue Marketing (International)
jobs.description: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies. Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures. We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD. ABOUT THE TEAM Immuta’s marketing team sits at the intersection of data, AI, and enterprise growth. We turn a complex, important market problem into clear stories and meaningful connections with the people and organizations Immuta serves. We are building a thoughtful, modern marketing organization—one that values strong fundamentals, smart experimentation, useful data, and the judgment to know when a local insight should change the broader conversation. This team brings Immuta’s global story to life in markets around the world. We work across cultures, customer needs, and market dynamics while staying connected to a shared purpose and a high standard of execution. For marketers who enjoy learning quickly, making sense of complexity, and helping a growing company earn trust in new markets, this is an opportunity to have visible impact with a genuinely global team. ABOUT THE ROLE As Principal, Revenue Marketing (International), you will help shape how Immuta shows up in markets beyond its home base. This individual contributer role offers unusual strategic latitude: you will bring together customer insight, commercial context, and a point of view on where the company can create the most value. You will have the opportunity to influence the way Immuta earns attention, builds credibility, and grows relationships across a diverse set of international audiences. You’ll be part of a team that values clear thinking, thoughtful challenge, and momentum. The work will suit someone who enjoys navigating ambiguity, connecting people around a shared direction, and turning good ideas into progress. You will have visibility with senior partners across the business, the freedom to use your judgment, and the chance to help define how an ambitious data and AI company grows around the world. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior SEM Manager</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3">We’re looking for a Senior SEM Manager to run Paid Search execution across our European launch markets, reporting to the Director of SEM.
