jobs.title: ISO 27001 Auditor
jobs.description: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor Calibre | Permanent, full-time | London office, five days a week About Calibre Calibre is building an AI-native certification body. Our platform helps auditors review evidence, document findings and prepare reports, giving them more time to test whether controls work in practice. Auditors retain responsibility for every finding. The role We’re hiring a Lead Auditor to deliver independent ISO/IEC 27001 certification audits, witness new auditors and help shape the tools our audit team uses. You’ll work with colleagues in certification, product and engineering to make the audit process clearer and easier to use. What you’ll do Lead Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits, as well as surveillance and recertification audits. Plan audit activities, select defensible samples and test whether information security controls operate in practice. Write evidence-based findings and reports, and follow up on nonconformities and corrective actions. Maintain audit files that stand up to review, protect impartiality and keep certification decisions independent of the audit team. Witness new auditors in practice, document what you observe and give clear feedback. Use Calibre’s platform in live audits and show the product team where changes would improve evidence review, reporting or quality checks. What we’re looking for A current ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor qualification and a recent audit log. Experience leading third-party ISO 27001 certification audits in a certification-body setting. Enough hands-on understanding of cloud and security infrastructure to assess evidence such as IAM policies, infrastructure configuration and audit logs. Clear writing and sound audit judgement. You can explain your conclusions to a client’s technical team and defend them in a review. Interest in using AI-assisted tools in audit work and the judgement to verify their output against the underlying evidence. How to apply Create your Auditor Passport and upload your CV. If you have your Lead Auditor certificate and audit log to hand, please include those too. Compensation: £60K – £75K • 0.1% • Base Salary £60K – £75K • 0.1% Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. The role You’ll own the full sales cycle, from finding and qualifying the right businesses through to negotiating and closing. You’ll sell to founders, CFOs and Heads of Payments, often replacing an incumbent provider they’ve used for years. jobs.title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers on analysis and verification planning. Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline. 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Primary structure experience is a plus. Experience working in large, multi-person CAD assemblies, including top-down design, skeleton or master models, in-context references and configurations. Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging. Why NewOrbit Space?

jobs.title: Senior SecOps Engineer
jobs.description: About Equativ & Security team Equativ is an independent ad tech company. Our programmatic advertising platform runs at high scale, with production running entirely on Google Cloud Platform. Equativ is building its ISMS toward ISO 27001 certification, targeted by the end of 2027. The role You run day-to-day security operations for a full-cloud company as a senior engineer in the SecOps team, reporting to the SecOps Manager. You bring technical proposals to the SecOps Manager; the IT & Security lead approves the SecOps roadmap.  You back up the SecOps Manager on technical topics and during incidents.  You are also the link between SecOps and the other teams, mainly R&D, Platform Engineering and IT. You keep them in sync on security priorities, changes and incidents. You train them on secure practices and on the security tooling they use, so they can own security in their own areas. Most of your time goes into building and running things yourself. You write the Terraform, the detections and the automation. Responsibilities GCP guardrails and posture as code: definition, organization policies, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, KMS and Secret Manager; run our CSPM (Wiz); take controls from monitoring to enforcement with a rollback plan; deliver controls in Terraform and CI/CD policy checks with Platform Engineering. Detection and incident response: own log pipelines (Cloud Logging, audit logs, Workspace, Okta, CrowdStrike), build detections end to end (log onboarding, SIEM use cases, validation) and manage alert quality, automating triage and enrichment; lead security incidents from triage to root cause and post-mortem, including GCP forensics; maintain playbooks and run tabletop exercises. Vulnerability and attack-surface management: cloud, containers (GKE, Artifact Registry), dependencies and external surface; prioritize findings on exploitability and real exposure; run the technical side of external pentests (scoping, challenging findings, retest) and drive remediation with owning teams and track SLAs. Secure development: threat-model new services with R&D; embed SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning and supply-chain controls in the SDLC; be the security contact for each R&D team. Assurance: produce technical evidence for ISO 27001 audits; answer the technical part of customer security questionnaires and RFPs, including non-standard requests; assess the security of third-party vendors. FinOps: know the cost of the security tooling you deploy, flag cost drifts early and work with Procurement on cost estimates when selecting security vendors. Must-have profile 7+ years in security engineering or SecOps, including 3+ years securing production on a public cloud — GCP strongly preferred, AWS/Azure transferable. Deep GCP security knowledge: IAM model, org policies, VPC-SC, SCC, logging, GKE security. Hands-on experience with cloud-native security platforms such as Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center (SCC) and Wiz (or similar CNAPPs). Hands-on incident response experience, including leading incidents and cloud forensics. Detection engineering with a SIEM and log pipelines at scale. Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and scripting. Clear written and spoken English and French; able to explain risk to engineers and to customers. Skills in project management Proactive, bring forward proposals and make recommendations Nice to have Kubernetes / GKE hardening and runtime security. Experience in ad tech or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive platforms. Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the operations side. IS simplification: reduce the complexity of the tribe’s information system, remove duplication, and make the architecture easier to run and evolve. Missions are short and outcome-driven: you join a topic, deliver, hand over to the owning product team, and move on to the next one.  🎯 TASK Strategic & Hard Problems Take on the domain’s most difficult and strategic topics: legacy decommissioning, IS simplification, complex features in existing products. Contribute, with the Architects, to the decommissioning of legacy systems end to end: map dependencies and data flows, design the migration path, run it without business disruption, and switch the legacy off. Drive the simplification of the tribe’s information system: identify redundant components, unnecessary coupling and dead code, and remove them. Fast Onboarding & Delivery Land in any product or codebase of the domain and become productive in days, not months. Quickly understand the business context, the architecture, the constraints and the people involved in a topic. Hand over cleanly to the owning product team: documentation, tests, runbooks and knowledge transfer, so that the team can run what you built. Problem Framing & Business Partnership Take ill-defined, poorly framed problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans. Navigate between tech and business: understand the business stakes, challenge the need with a “how yes” mindset, and propose the simplest solution that delivers the value. Partner with business teams, PMs/POs and Engineering Managers to shape the problem, identify rabbit holes, no-gos and hidden complexity, and agree on scope. Think business value first: explain the value of every technical investment, legacy removal and simplification included. Be the person the business can count on: reliable, transparent on risks, and committed to outcomes. Engineering Excellence & Technical Leadership Own the how end to end: architecture, libraries, data model, implementation, testing and deployment. Write production code: you are hands-on and contribute heavily to the implementation. Make sound technical trade-offs and document key decisions. Raise the bar in the teams you work with: code quality, testing, operability, and AI-first

jobs.title: Working Student MDR
jobs.description: About the Role Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step. That's where you come in. As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR) , you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo. You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey. This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact. It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension. About Trengo Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture. What your role looks like: Turn inbound interest into opportunities Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day. Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting. Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step. Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation. Help prospects become self-serve customers Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo. Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan. Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers. Improve how we engage with leads Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best. Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data. How we'll measure success You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track: Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention. Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives. Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers. Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve. The tools you'll work with You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit: HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling. RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking. Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching. Slack & Notion

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
jobs.description: Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source. Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement. You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work. This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. The problems you'll own A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress What you'll do Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work Report agent qual

jobs.title: Senior Process Integration Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! Your work will be essential in ensuring that new products and technologies can be reliably manufactured with the required performance, quality, and yield. What you'll be doing Lead the integration and transfer of new products, processes and technologies from R&D into manufacturing. Define and develop manufacturing process flows, process specifications and control strategies for new product introductions. Work closely with R&D and cross-functional teams to ensure new products are designed and released with manufacturability, quality and scalability in mind. Plan and execute process integration activities, including process development, qualification, validation, and release. Identify, investigate and resolve process integration issues, yield losses, and technical anomalies. Drive continuous process and yield improvements using structured problem-solving and data-driven approaches. Support the transition and scaling of manufacturing capabilities, including the implementation of new equipment, automation, and MES systems. Develop and maintain key process and quality documentation, including Process FMEAs, Control Plans, process specifications, work instructions and change control documentation. Participate in and support technical review and decision-making processes, including Change Control Boards (CCB) and Material Review Boards (MRB). Work with Operations and Manufacturing teams to establish stable, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing processes. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers as the Process Integration team grows. Your Profile 4+ years of experience in Process Integration, Process Engineering, NPI, Yield Engineering, or a related engineering role. A Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred. Experience working in a semiconductor startup, microfabrication foundry, advanced manufacturing or other high-tech hardware environment. Strong understanding of process development, process integration, qualification, and manufacturing transfer. Experience with structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, SPC, DOE or similar tools. Experience in analysing process and manufacturing data to identify root causes and improve process performance and yield. Familiarity with quality and manufacturing systems, including Control Plans, non-conformance management, change control and corrective/preventive actions. Experience working in cross-functional environments involving R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality. Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description: About Invisix Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger. The Role We're looking for a System Architect to decide what our metrology equipment is and why it's built that way: concept choices, system decomposition, budget allocations and the technology roadmap amongst others. Reporting to our CTO, you look two to five years ahead and beyond, and shape our product line across several generations, so that what we build today still makes sense for our customers tomorrow. You work with our customers' technology roadmaps, marketing, the heads of R&D, our function architects and customer support, and you lead through persuasion rather than formal authority. Our system engineer builds on your concept and makes the current program work to spec. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe. Key Responsibilities Own the system architecture of our metrology product line, looking two to five years ahead and beyond, across several product generations Make and justify the key concept choices, weighing physics, performance, cost and risk Decompose the system into modules and interfaces, and allocate the key budgets, such as throughput, cost of goods, availability and performance Translate our customers' technology roadmaps and future needs into product requirements, together with marketing and customers Define our platform and reuse strategy, and decide which technologies we invest in Align the heads of R&D and our function architects behind the architecture, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as representing Invisix in technical discussions with customers and partners Is this you? MSc or PhD in physics, applied physics, electrical or mechanical engineering or a related field, with at least 10 years of experience developing complex high-tech equipment, including a role as system or product architect Experience in semiconductor equipment, for example lithography, metrology or inspection, or in comparable high-tech equipment, ideally with a product that made it to customers Strong physics depth, in optics or measurement physics, so you can judge concept choices on their physical merits Experience making architecture trade-offs across mechanics, electronics, optics and software, and setting system budgets for performance, throughput and cost A preference for breadth over depth, comfort with ambiguity, the ability to make sound decisions on incomplete data, and the skill to persuade without formal authority Active use of AI tooling in your daily work (concept studies, trade-off analysis, documentation) to boost efficiency Nice to have Experience working with the technology roadmaps of leading semiconductor manufacturers Experience defining a product platform or reuse strategy across several generations Experience balancing cost of goods and cost of service against performance Experience in a startup or scale-up What We Offer A role at the heart of Invisix's product, shaping what our metrology equipment will be over several generations Competitive salary and benefits, including an Employee Share Ownership Plan A learning and development budget to support your growth Flexible working arrangements, and room to grow into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales Interested? jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Als Online Marketing Stagiair(e) bij Flagship Amsterdam krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan de online zichtbaarheid van deze unieke rondvaartorganisatie en al haar labels, zoals Flagship Bike Tours, Aemstelland en Voyage. Je denkt mee over hoe we potentiële gasten bereiken en ervoor zorgen dat zij uiteindelijk bij ons boeken. Tijdens deze stage doe je brede praktijkervaring op binnen online marketing. Wat ga je leren? Uitvoeren van zoekwoordenonderzoek en toepassen van SEO; Optimaliseren van webpagina's en verbeteren van de gebruikerservaring; Ondersteunen bij het opzetten en uitvoeren van online campagnes; Werken met website- en campagnedata om resultaten inzichtelijk te maken; Analyseren van het gedrag van websitebezoekers en de boekingsflow; Samenwerken met externe marketingpartners en leren werken met marketingbriefings. Praktisch Startdatum: februari 2027; Duur: minimaal 5 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Stagevergoeding: €500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam. Wat we aanbieden Goede begeleiding van ervaren collega's, met ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling; Een leerzame stage waarin je kennismaakt met verschillende aspecten van de organisatie en veel praktijkervaring opdoet; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; Een gezellige en informele werksfeer met gezamenlijke lunch op ons kantoor in hartje Amsterdam; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding. Functievereisten Je volgt een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in een relevant vakgebied, zoals marketing, communicatie of commerciële economie; Je beheerst zowel Nederlands als Engels goed; Je hebt affiniteit met online marketing en bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe websites en online campagnes werken; Je werkt nauwkeurig, bent analytisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om met cijfers bezig te zijn; Je neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen; Ervaring met SEO, online advertenties of websitebeheer is mooi meegenomen. Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most. Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan. Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors. Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows. What you'll bring 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment. Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll. Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team. A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically. Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch. Remote-first flexibility , with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs. This role will support our Global Data Centre (GDC) environment, requiring a candidate who understands the operational and technical challenges of delivering robust, scalable, and secure data platforms within isolated infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and data engineering teams to build and maintain reliable data processing capabilities. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters in on-premises and air-gapped environments. Manage the full lifecycle of Hadoop/Spark platforms, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and distributed data processing. Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management. Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements. Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm. Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh. Ensure software dependencies, container images, packages, and platform components can be deployed and maintained without external internet connectivity. Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation. Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM. Requirements Required Technical Skills & Experience 1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters. Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads. Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines. Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments. 2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments. Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management. Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories. Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards. 3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments. Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments. Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication. Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture. 4. Data Systems & Engineering Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains</h1> <h2>About Flexport</h2> <p>Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.</p> <p>Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.</p> <p>Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.</p> <p>Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at <a href="https://amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com">amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com</a>.</p> <h2>The team: Autonomous Supply Chains</h2> <p>Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.</p> <p>Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications t

jobs.title: Webentwickler für interne Tools & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du entwickelst unsere interne Software weiter, baust Benutzeroberflächen mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools und automatisierst Abläufe mit n8n und KI. Dafür bringst du praktische Programmiererfahrung mit. Ein bis zwei Jahre technische Praxis reichen für den Einstieg aus , wenn du bestehenden Code lesen, Änderungen selbst umsetzen und Fehler eingrenzen kannst. Wir sind AdKochMarketing , eine Recruiting- und Employer-Branding-Agentur für das Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen. Von unserem Hamburger Büro aus betreuen wir Kunden in der DACH-Region und haben bereits über 250 Projekte umgesetzt. Deine Anwendungen und Automationen nutzt unser Team täglich im Recruiting, in der Kampagnensteuerung und im Reporting. Deine Aufgaben Interne Software weiterentwickeln. Du arbeitest dich in unsere bestehenden Anwendungen ein, setzt Änderungen im Code um und baust neue Frontends und Benutzeroberflächen mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools. Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren. Du schaust dir an, welche Arbeitsschritte sich im Team wiederholen, und entwickelst dafür zuverlässige Workflows mit n8n, Make oder vergleichbaren Tools. KI-Agenten und Prompts entwickeln. Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows, testest ihre Ergebnisse anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle und verbesserst sie für den täglichen Einsatz. Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse aufbauen. Du verbindest CRM, externe Datenquellen und weitere SaaS-Tools über APIs. Du entwickelst Workflows, die Daten erfassen, anreichern und ans CRM übergeben. Datenbanken und Infrastruktur betreuen. Du pflegst Datenstrukturen in Supabase und Airtable und betreust unsere Anwendungen auf UpCloud. Fehler beheben und technische Abläufe dokumentieren. Du findest heraus, warum ein Workflow oder eine Anwendung ausfällt, behebst die Ursache und hältst die wichtigsten Abläufe so fest, dass das Team sie nachvollziehen kann. Technische Lösungen fürs Team umsetzen. Du klärst Anforderungen mit den Kollegen, führst bei Bedarf neue Tools ein und hilfst bei technischen Fragen zu unseren internen Systemen. Das bringst du mit 1-2 Jahre technisches Grundverständnis und praktische Programmiererfahrung. Du kannst dich in vorhandenen Code einarbeiten, Änderungen selbst umsetzen und Fehler systematisch eingrenzen. JavaScript oder TypeScript passen besonders gut zu unserem Stack. Andere Programmiersprachen wie Python sind ebenfalls eine gute Grundlage. Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in einem IT-Bereich, z.B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Fachinformatik, Elektrotechnik bzw. andere nachweisbare Erfahrung im Bereich IT / Automatisierung Interesse an Frontends und Low-Code. Du möchtest interne Benutzeroberflächen entwickeln und arbeitest dich selbstständig in die dafür nötigen Tools ein. Struktur- und Prozessdenken. Du verstehst, wie Abläufe zusammenhängen, arbeitest dich in bestehende Prozesse ein und entwickelst Lösungen, die sich im Alltag zuverlässig nutzen und pflegen lassen. Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Du kannst Anforderungen mit dem Team klären und technische Abläufe verständlich dokumentieren. Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, mit Next.js oder Low-Code-Frontends sowie mit APIs, Supabase, Airtable oder SQL. Auch Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Gemini und mit CRM-Anbindungen ist willkommen. Das bieten wir dir 💸 4.000–5.000 € brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung. 🏡 Vor Ort oder hybrid. Du kannst vollständig in unserem Hamburger Büro arbeiten oder hybrid mit 3 Tagen vor Ort und 2 Tagen im Homeoffice pro Woche . Unser Büro liegt in der Spaldingstraße 218 20097 Hamburg, 3. OG. ⚙️ Eigene technische Projekte. Du begleitest interne Anwendungen und Automationen von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz. Bei der Umsetzung bringst du deine eigenen Ideen ein. 🚀 Ergebnisse, die du im Alltag siehst. Das Team nutzt deine Lösungen im Recruiting, in der Kampagnensteuerung und im Reporting. Du bekommst direktes Feedback und siehst, welche Arbeitsschritte deine Lösungen verei

jobs.title: Venture Development Manager (AI Transformation)
jobs.description: Digitale Transformation mit KI Excelling Ventures ist eine Investmentgesellschaft und baut durch innovative Technologien angetriebene Consumer Brands auf. Als Venture Development Manager (AI Transformation) gestaltest du die KI-Strategie und -Implementierung in unserem Portfolio aktiv mit. Wir suchen eine Person, die selbst baut: in jedes Portfoliounternehmen geht, erkennt, wo AI Agents echten Hebel schaffen, und sie eigenständig und schnell in den Produktivbetrieb bringt. Dein Erfolg misst sich an ausgerollten Agents, eingesparten Stunden und echter Nutzung in den Teams – nicht an Strategiepräsentationen. Aufgaben (Responsibilities) Analysieren und priorisieren Führe AI-Audits in jedem Portfoliounternehmen durch: Workflows, Datenquellen und Tool-Landschaft erfassen und die Automatisierungschancen mit dem höchsten ROI identifizieren. Baue pro Unternehmen ein priorisiertes Use-Case-Backlog auf (Impact × Aufwand) und stimme es mit dem jeweiligen CEO ab. AI Agents bauen und ausrollen Konzipiere, entwickle und implementiere AI Agents eigenständig und end-to-end über alle Funktionen hinweg: Kundenservice, Performance Marketing, Content- und Creator-Operations, E-Commerce und Order-Operations, Finance und Reporting sowie internes Wissensmanagement. Binde die Agents an die Systeme der Unternehmen an (z. B. Shopify, CRM, Helpdesk, Werbeplattformen, ERP, Google Workspace, Slack, Airtable) – über APIs, MCP-Server und Workflow-Tools. Bring Lösungen in Wochen statt Quartalen vom Prototyp in den Produktivbetrieb – inklusive Evaluation, Guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop, Monitoring und Kostenkontrolle. AI Adoption vorantreiben Schule Teams praxisnah, etabliere interne Champions und mache AI-Tools zum festen Bestandteil des Arbeitsalltags statt zum Nebenprojekt. Miss Nutzung und Wirkung pro Unternehmen (Nutzungsrate, eingesparte Stunden, Kosten pro Ticket, Durchlaufzeit) und berichte monatlich an den Founder und die Portfolio-CEOs. Über das Portfolio skalieren Übertrage, was in einem Unternehmen funktioniert, in wiederverwendbare Playbooks, Templates und Agent-Bausteine für das nächste. Etabliere eine schlanke AI-Governance-Basis: Datenschutz (DSGVO / Schweizer DSG), Zugriffsrechte, Anbieterauswahl und Modellwahl. Verfolge die schnelllebige AI-Landschaft und entscheide pragmatisch, was übernommen, was selbst gebaut und was ignoriert wird. Anforderungen (Requirements) Must-have Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit AI Agents oder LLM-Workflows, die du in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht hast und die tatsächlich genutzt werden – zeig sie uns (Repo, Demo, Case Study). Starke Hands-on-Skills: Python oder TypeScript, REST-APIs und Webhooks, LLM-APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI o. ä.), Tool Use / Function Calling, RAG sowie Agent-Frameworks oder MCP. Sicherer Umgang mit No-Code-/Low-Code-Automatisierung (n8n, Make, Zapier o. ä.) und das Urteilsvermögen, wann Code die bessere Wahl ist. Unternehmerisches Verständnis: Du verstehst P&L, Unit Economics und operative Abläufe und priorisierst nach ROI, nicht nach technischer Neuheit. Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstständigkeit: Du arbeitest ohne fertige Spezifikation, schneidest Probleme selbst zu und lieferst. Du kannst nicht-technische Teams schulen und für neue Tools gewinnen – Adoption ist die halbe Arbeit. Fließend Deutsch und Englisch; Italienisch ist ein Plus. Nice-to-have Erfahrung in D2C / E-Commerce, Performance Marketing, Creator- oder Influencer-Commerce Hintergrund in einem Startup, Scale-up oder einem Portfolio-Operations- bzw. Value-Creation-Team von PE / VC. Erfahrung mit Evaluation-Frameworks, LLM-Observability und Kostenoptimierung. Was wir bieten Direkter Draht zum Founder und zu den Portfolio-CEOs: kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Konzernstrukturen. Echte Wirkung in mehreren Unternehmen gleichzeitig – mit der Freiheit, Tools und Vorgehen selbst zu wählen. Budget für AI-Tools, APIs und Infrastruktur. Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit einer leistungsabhängigen Komponente, gekoppelt an messbare Ergebnisse. Bewerbung

This role turns shared commercial priorities into practical, measurable marketing programs that help DT and Horizon3 create demand, engage customers, equip partner teams, and grow pipeline for cybersecurity services built around the NodeZero™ platform. Working closely with the Deutsche Telekom business unit director, channel sales, regional sales, and EMEA marketing, you will connect partner strategy to execution. You will shape joint plans, coordinate stakeholders across both organisations, and measure what marketing contributes—from partner engagement and qualified leads through to pipeline and revenue influence. This is a hands-on role for someone who can navigate a complex partner environment and make progress through influence rather than direct authority. About Horizon3 Horizon3 is a fast-growing cybersecurity company on a mission to help organisations find, fix, and verify exploitable attack paths before attackers exploit them. Its flagship NodeZero™ platform delivers production-safe autonomous penetration testing and other security assessment capabilities across internal, external, cloud, and hybrid environments. NodeZero is used by organisations ranging from small institutions to Global 100 enterprises, as well as by security teams, consultants, and managed service providers. Align campaign outcomes, ownership, timelines, success measures, and follow-up with the business unit director and DT stakeholders; build effective relationships across DT marketing, sales, channel, and service teams. Develop trusted working relationships across DT marketing, sales, channel, and relevant service teams, coordinating decisions and execution across a large, matrixed organisation. Deliver integrated, German-language campaigns for DT’s B2B audiences across events, roundtables, webinars, digital, account-based marketing, partner communications, and sales plays. Support joint customer engagement and co-selling with account-specific programs and coordinated sales follow-up. Develop demand-generation programs that support DT’s reseller, service-provider, and managed security service motions. Plan and manage market development funds (MDF) and other co-marketing investment in line with agreed priorities, budgets, governance, and campaign objectives. Build and run enablement programmes, alongside the Horizon3 Channel Team to equip DT sales and partner teams with clear NodeZero positioning, customer value, campaign offers, and calls to action. Coordinate campaign enablement with channel, product marketing, and solutions engineering. Track partner engagement, lead quality, conversion, sourced and influenced pipeline, and campaign return. Share performance insights and recommendations in regular updates and quarterly business reviews, and contribute successful programs to EMEA playbooks. Experience working with telco resellers, telecommunications providers, systems integrators, distributors, MSSPs/MSPs, or comparable

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still clicks through CAD trees, searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products : one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. Driving product initiatives with founders and engineers. Help frame the problem, facilitate decisions and turn a direction into projects and tasks the team can execute. Making the product coherent as it grows. Own interaction and visual quality, including the design system, without slowing down experimentation. WHAT WE CARE ABOUT You have shipped complex software products for expert users and can point to the decisions you made, not just the final screens. You are comfortable when the problem is not yet defined. You form your own opinion, push back and help create clarity. You have strong product judgment . You know when to research, when to prototype, when to polish and when to ship. You are comfortable working directly with customers and software engineers , and you learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You have strong interaction and visual craft and are comfortable with Figma, prototyping in code and AI-assisted workflows . You are fluent in German and English . Bonus: CAD, 3D, PLM, industrial software, AI agents or other highly technical products. None required. HOW TO APPLY Via Ashby with: Your CV Your portfolio – at least two case studies of complex B2B or AI products, showing your process, not just final screens A link to something you prototyped in code or with AI tools – rough is fine A 2-min intro video (any format you like) A short answer to: "What is the most complex workflow you have simplified – what made it hard, and what did you decide to leave out?" jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee. What we are looking for: Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our EMEA team. What you will be doing: As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximise opportunities for our Enterprise Business customers and Semperis. Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions. You will be responsible for: Design a success plan for a Book of Business of strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upsell, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets Act as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations Monitor record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalised customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc Develop and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.) Identify potential customer references and assist with development of customer case studies Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program What you will bring to the table: Technical & Cyber Security Skills Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organisation structures Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains: Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2) Customer-facing & Soft Skills - 5+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager

We're looking for someone who brings strong Finance foundations, sound judgment, and the ambition to take on broader responsibilities as the company grows. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! Manage the financial aspects of our European Chips Act funding and other public funding programs. Establish scalable financial processes and internal controls that support our manufacturing operations and international growth. Improve our financial systems and ERP landscape, actively leveraging AI and automation to build an efficient Finance function. Develop our lean Finance team and manage relationships with banks, auditors, tax advisors and other external partners. Every tenant, every user, every permission on our sovereign cloud runs through the services this squad builds, and so does every euro that gets billed. We are the Business Logic squad in the Cloud Store team at gridscale, part of OVHcloud, and we build the backend layer of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform: identity and access management, consumption tracking and billing for enterprise customers who run their cloud on their own premises, often fully air-gapped. Our first fully integrated release is out, and the next step is taking it to production grade, while the platform is becoming the foundation on which other OVHcloud products build their sovereign offerings. The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. With us, you'll push this practice further across the squad and beyond. Shape the squad's agentic engineering practice : agent workflows, context and guardrails, review standards for AI-generated code , and how we measure the impact. Design our REST APIs so they can evolve without breaking the teams and customers who depend on them. Build authentication and authorization flows on OAuth2/OIDC . Make asynchronous, distributed workflows reliable: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures. Drive technical design in the squad: make architecture calls, document key decisions and review your teammates' designs and code. Mentor other engineers and help the squad raise its engineering bar , including how it builds with AI agents. jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role Our models need someone who knows them inside out — not just what they can do today, but what nobody has tried yet. You'll create the work that makes people realize what's possible with generative media: original pieces, experiments, and creative assets that set the standard for what FLUX can do, and show it to the world. What You'll Work On Build end-to-end production workflows that push FLUX to its limits — experiments, visual explorations, and pieces tailored to brand, agency, and entertainment use cases that show what's possible before anyone else figures it out. Test and explore models, endpoints, and features that are still in development — you're the one figuring out what they can actually do, and turning that into new insights for image, video generation and more Create and maintain a library of demo boards, templates, and pipelines that make the product's value obvious in live pitches. Partner with Sales and FDEs on discovery and demo prep, and document what works so it scales across the team. Support customer enablement - help define what's feasible for custom projects, fine-tuning, and creative workflows. Work with DevRel, Product, Marketing and Growth to turn experiments into shareable, reproducible examples and insights. What We're Looking For 3+ years in creative technology, digital art, or experimental media. You use generative AI for image and video every day, deeply and practically — enough to know intuitively where it breaks down and where it delivers. A portfolio that demonstrates strong taste, solid craft, and versatility across mediums and tools. Background in brand, agency, or film/VFX work — you understand the real process behind shipping professional creative. You move easily through the FLUX ecosystem and the tools around it, from ComfyUI to AI Toolkit and beyond. Deep understanding of generative AI, agents, and diffusion models. Working knowledge of Python for scripting and rapid prototyping. Nice to Have Active presence in the creative AI community (X, Discord, YouTube) — you're already someone people follow for generative AI work. Experience creating content that got real traction in the AI/creative space. Experience supporting Sales or GTM teams with creative assets and technical feasibility assessments. How We Work Together We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Freiburg or SF and work from the office at least 2 days a week. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you. jobs.title: Industrial Architect (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As Industrial Architect (all genders), you will design the Microliner industrial system from a Manufacturing Engineering perspective. Reporting to the SVP Industrial, your first priority is the build concept for the first conforming prototype: how the aircraft will be assembled, integrated, inspected, tested, supplied, and controlled. You will evolve this concept across the subsequent conforming prototypes into the industrial architecture for VÆRIDION’s series Final Assembly Line and POA-ready production system. Working closely with the Structures Architect and the wider Engineering organisation, as well as the Head of Assembly, Quality, Supply Chain, and Procurement, you will ensure that product architecture and industrial architecture develop together and turn the aircraft design into an executable and scalable manufacturing system. Your Day-to-Day: Own the industrial architecture and first conforming prototype build concept as your immediate priority, creating one integrated view of how the aircraft will be manufactured, assembled, integrated, inspected, tested, supplied, and completed. Translate the aircraft design into the manufacturing bill of material, bill of process, work packages, build sequence, stations, inspection points, and test flow. Work closely with the Structures Architect and wider Engineering organisation to define Manufacturing Engineering requirements and drive Design for Manufacture and Assembly, covering structural breakdown, major joins, installation sequence, access, interfaces, tolerances, tooling references, ergonomics, inspectability, repeatability, and production risk. Define the tooling, jigs, fixtures, lifting, handling, and production-equipment architecture, including requirements, make-or-buy recommendations, qualification, and delivery priorities. Design the prototype assembly and future series FAL system, including layouts, stations, material flow, kitting, logistics, utilities, safety, and capacity. Create labour, skill, cycle-time, capacity, resource, and capital-expenditure models for the conforming prototypes and series production. Define production-data requirements, including released work instructions, configuration and change control, as-built records, traceability, non-conformance data, and performance feedback. Establish industrial-readiness criteria and controlled processes that support safe prototype builds and VÆRIDION’s transition towards its own EASA Part-21 Subpart G Production Organisation Approval. Work closely with the Head of Assembly during the prototype builds, resolving gaps and converting build learning into controlled improvements for subsequent aircraft and the series FAL. Maintain the industrial-system roadmap from first conforming prototype through subsequent prototypes, POA readiness, and scalable series production. Your Profile: Degree in aerospace, mechanical, industrial, manufacturing, production engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. 10+ years in Manufacturing Engineering, industrial engineering, production-system architecture, or aircraft industrialisation. Demonstrated experience creating the manufacturing concept for a first-of-type product and evolving it through conforming prototypes into series production. Strong command of manufacturing bills of material and process, build sequencing, work packaging, station design, capacity modelling, and production readiness. Strong knowledge of tooling, factory layout, material flow, ergonomics, process risk, standard work, and Design for Manufacture and Assembly. Practical understanding of Part-21G/POA principles, configuration, traceability, production conformity, non-conformance control, and controlled production records. Experience defining production-data and work-instruction requirements; familiarity with PLM, ERP, MES, or QMS environments is beneficial. Excellent written and spoken English. jobs.title: Head of Assembly (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As Head of Assembly (all genders), you will lead the build and final assembly of VÆRIDION’s first conforming Microliner and the subsequent conforming prototypes. Reporting to the SVP Industrial, you will coordinate a lean internal team and experienced external production partners, ensuring build readiness, conformity, quality, schedule, cost, and configuration. In parallel, you will build VÆRIDION’s assembly capability as part of the company’s transition towards its own EASA Part-21 Subpart G Production Organisation Approval (POA). Following the prototype phase, you will lead the establishment, ramp-up, and operation of the series Final Assembly Line. Define and build the phased assembly organisation: start with a lean internal team and external production partners, then progressively develop VÆRIDION’s own people, processes, and controlled production capability towards its Part-21G POA and series Final Assembly Line. Lead the industrial interface with aerostructure, major-assembly, systems-integration, and other production partners, ensuring mature, conforming, complete, and timely deliveries into final assembly. Establish clear build governance across VÆRIDION and its partners, including work-package ownership, decision rights, conformity interfaces, build-readiness reviews, escalation, and recovery routines. Translate the aircraft plan into an executable assembly plan, maintain control of the critical path, and lead daily performance, issue resolution, and recovery. Ensure build readiness, including released engineering data, approved instructions, complete kits, tooling, qualified personnel, inspection points, and a safe workplace. Establish aviation-grade standards for safety, workmanship, configuration control, traceability, conformity, tool control, and accurate aircraft build records, supporting VÆRIDION’s future POA. Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Engineering, and Certification to resolve first-build issues, non-conformances, deviations, and design changes through approved processes. Capture first-aircraft learning with the Industrial Architect and Manufacturing Engineering and carry it into subsequent conforming prototypes and the future series assembly system. After the conforming-prototype phase, lead the establishment, industrial readiness, ramp-up, and performance of VÆRIDION’s series Final Assembly Line. Your Profile: Degree in aerospace, mechanical, production, manufacturing, industrial engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. A technician or master craft qualification combined with substantial aircraft-production leadership experience may also be considered. 12+ years in aircraft assembly, final assembly, major-component assembly, systems integration, or conforming-prototype manufacturing, including leadership of multidisciplinary production teams. Demonstrated senior leadership in aircraft build and final assembly; experience establishing, ramping, or leading a Final Assembly Line is highly valued. Strong practical knowledge of aircraft structures and systems installation, build sequencing, work-package control, tooling and fixtures, production documentation, inspection coordination, and resolution of first-build issues. Strong knowledge of aerospace production, Part-21G/POA principles, configuration control, traceability, production conformity, non-conformance management, and controlled build records. Experience building aircraft assembly capability through a phased model using external partners while progressively establishing internal people, processes, governance, and POA-ready operations. You will own integrated industrial delivery across build strategy, manufacturing planning, tooling, infrastructure, supplier and material readiness, shop-floor execution, configuration control, conformity, quality, and resolution of build issues. In parallel, you will strengthen the industrial system and organisation that carries the Microliner from the first conforming aircraft through the remaining certification aircraft, low-rate initial production, and scalable series production. As a member of the senior leadership team, you will shape company-wide operational decisions and have the potential to grow into the COO role as VÆRIDION scales. Your Day-to-Day: Lead VÆRIDION’s industrial organisation through the build and delivery of the first conforming Microliner prototype as the role’s immediate and highest-priority mission, taking integrated accountability for industrial planning, build readiness, execution, schedule, quality, cost, and successful completion of the aircraft. Build and lead the industrial organisation across Prototype Manufacturing, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Operations, industrial infrastructure, tooling and automation, production planning and control, logistics, and warehouse operations. Bring together and lead the integrated build organisation for the first conforming prototype, aligning the established work of Prototype Manufacturing, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Operations, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, and suppliers. Own the integrated build sequence, work packages, material and supplier readiness, work instructions, tooling, jigs, fixtures, equipment qualification, operator readiness, daily build control, issue resolution, configuration discipline, and the structured transfer of learning into subsequent aircraft and the production system. Lead the establishment and approval of VÆRIDION’s Production Organisation under EASA Part-21 Subpart G (POA), including the production organisation exposition, accountable governance, nominated functions, procedures, competence framework, independent quality assurance, supplier control, production conformity, and coordination with the competent authority. Drive production quality, configuration discipline, traceability, non-conformance management, and continuous improvement in close cooperation with Quality, Engineering, and Certification. Create and manage the integrated industrial plan, including build schedules, resource and capacity planning, critical-path management, industrial risk, and recovery actions. Develop the industrial supplier interface with Procurement and Engineering, ensuring suppliers can meet technical maturity, quality, capacity, cost, and delivery requirements. Establish industrial KPIs and management routines covering safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and ramp-up maturity. Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing, hands-on team while building a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, practical problem-solving, and aviation-grade safety and quality. jobs.description: Your Mission: As a Working Student Embedded Software (all genders), you will work on our high voltage propulsion battery prototypes, lifting our battery management software stack onto its next level. Strong understanding of data integration, ETL development, data quality and production troubleshooting. Strong organisational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in an Agile environment.
