jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.   This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success. This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.  You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.  You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. In this role, you will:   Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations. Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry. Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc. Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use. Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultan

jobs.title: Senior Technical Programme Manager - Money
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Team At DoorDash we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It's no simple task, but it wouldn't be interesting if it was! About the Role Money is DoorDash's organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. They require strong technical judgment, cross organisational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results. You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Drive Money Domain's Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy & Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Money Domain's strategy into executable technical programs.  Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution — Money Domain interacts with capabilities across consumer, merchant, courier, order and enterprise domains, payment processing, payouts, fraud and risk, regulatory compliance, accounting, financial data and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious. Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking - You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, integrations, data flows, and operational systems behind Money Domain (Financial Systems). You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect end-to-end consumer, rider/ courier, and merchant experiences, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs. Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action - Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind. Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes - You will understand the merchant, partner, customer, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution.  We're excited about you because… You're experienced in working with engineering teams on  large-scale distributed systems and/or b2b products. You can speak to system architecture, scalability and reliability decisions, and design trade offs. jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Growth Partnerships + New Audiences
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Consumer About the Team The EMEA Consumer Strategy & Operations team drives efficient customer growth across Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to help consumers discover the best in their neighborhood and make ordering a trusted, valuable part of everyday life. We identify emerging customer needs and translate them into strategies that attract new customers, deepen engagement, and build lasting loyalty. Ultimately, we champion the consumer at every step—making Deliveroo and Wolt feel local, relevant, and delightful. About the Role In this role, you will work cross-functionally with business development, marketing, product, engineering, and design teams to drive growth across growth partnerships and under penetrated audience segments. jobs.title: SAP Engineer
jobs.description: TL;DR: We're looking for exceptional SAP engineers eager to build the AI layer for operating the world’s most complex IT setups. This role moves beyond just ABAP: you’ll develop software across the stack, design AI harnesses and agents, influence product direction, and work with customers. Why Conduct Today, no single person fully understands their ERP setup: decades of customisation, millions of lines of ABAP, and undocumented changes from thousands of consultants has led to spiralling complexity. As a result, projects take years and migrations costs hundreds of millions. Conduct lets IT teams run faster. Teams collaborate alongside AI agents to accelerate their work, be it fit-gap analyses, hypercare support, deciphering business processes, writing ABAP, and more. We believe this is a generation-defining mission: by accelerating IT, businesses can evolve faster, unlocking productivity across industries. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $50M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct. We value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we'll make sure this is the place you do yours too. Who We Hire We're looking for an developer who understands ABAP inside out, down into implementation and runtime details, and is excited about what becomes possible when you put AI on top of it. You'll stand out if you: Have experience of hands-on ABAP and SAP development experience: technical consultant, ABAP developer, solutions architect, or similar Understand how SAP systems are actually structured beneath the surface: data models, BAPIs, IDocs, function modules, enhancement frameworks Have worked within or alongside large SAP implementations and migrations, understanding the complexities that arise from these Are eager to work beyond ABAP, including in writing AI agents, backend and frontend, infrastructure, etc. Bring strong, pragmatic engineering instincts and care about code that holds up in production at enterprise scale We hire the best, wherever they come from: we sponsor visas and are based in London. We believe diverse teams build better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. What You'll Own We don’t box people by background or role: if you have a strength in an area, we’d love for you to contribute. This means everything from writing developing our connector in ABAP, developing AI agents that execute ABAP development tasks, to contributing to product direction and implementation. You'll speak to customers, shape product direction, and ship things that run inside some of the most complex enterprise environments in the world. As an SAP specialist you’ll catch the edge cases, constraints, and quirks that only someone with that experience would spot. Our Stack Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers— fast —without compromising on quality and engineering. Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we’re sure you'll pick it up fast. Here’s our setup: ABAP: Custom reports to integrate ABAP-based systems with the Conduct platform React, Vite, TanStack frontend Kotlin backend: Modern and expressive, paired with the maturity, tooling, and depth of the Java ecosystem. Lets us ship fast now without painting ourselves into a corner later. Temporal and PortKey: Absorbs infrastructure complexity around durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing, so we can focus on shipping instead. Specialised LLM Harness: Built from hard-earned experience to give agents maximum freedom and intelligence without compromising on enterprise control, governance, or reliability. jobs.title: Data Protection Executive
jobs.description: 📍 Lincoln Hybrid – 2 days per week in our city centre office, with 3 days working from home Passionate about all things data protection? Looking for a role where you can take real ownership of your work and put your knowledge into practice? We're looking for a Data Protection Executive to join our Compliance team and help ensure we're doing the right thing when it comes to handling personal data across Goodlord. With the volume of personal data flowing through our platform, tenant referencing and insurance services, there's plenty to keep you busy! You'll take ownership of our day-to-day data protection activities, from managing data rights requests and maintaining our records to helping colleagues across the business navigate data protection queries with confidence. There's a task-driven element to this role, so you'll need to enjoy getting into the detail and managing a busy workload. But it's not just about ticking boxes. You'll be naturally curious, confident asking questions and keen to understand how we can improve the way we do things. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Managing data rights requests, including subject access requests, deletions and objections, ensuring they're handled accurately and within legislative timeframes. Providing practical data protection advice and guidance to colleagues across Goodlord, including our frontline Customer Support and Referencing teams. Taking ownership of our Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), working with stakeholders across the business to ensure they're accurate and up to date. Reviewing and maintaining our privacy notices to ensure they accurately reflect how we process personal data. Reviewing our existing data protection processes, ensuring we can demonstrate compliance and identifying opportunities to improve the way we do things. Supporting our Director of Compliance with risk assessments and the implementation of legislative changes. ABOUT YOU You should apply if you have: Hands-on, demonstrable experience in a dedicated data protection role, handling data requests, designing records of processing and having responsibility for legislative compliance. In-depth knowledge of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and an awareness of recent legislative developments. Experience managing subject access requests end to end, including the application of exemptions and redaction. Experience of completing data protection impact assessments and legitimate interest assessments Confidence working independently, prioritising your own workload and meeting legislative deadlines. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate legislative requirements into clear, practical guidance for colleagues across the business. It would also be great if you have: A relevant professional qualification, such as the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection or IAPP CIPP/E. Experience managing personal data breaches, including assessing whether they're reportable to the ICO. Experience working in an FCA-regulated firm, ideally within insurance. An understanding of the residential lettings sector, specifically the process of tenant referencing and associated data processing activities. We're not expecting you to know everything, but you'll need a solid grounding in data protection, the confidence to take ownership of your day-to-day responsibilities and the ability to recognise when to ask for support. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on. The team We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do. We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. The Role Siena's engineering team is small, senior and AI-native, and it ships across several products at once. This role leads a large part of that team, as a partner to engineering leadership, and owns how it scales. You will own delivery, hiring and team health for your part, and make sure a fast-moving team keeps shipping well across areas that look nothing alike. This is a hands-on leadership seat with a senior team and a lot of firefighting, not a layer of process. What You'll Do You will lead a large part of the engineering team, owning their delivery, priorities and growth. You will own hiring and planning for your part of the team, and keep raising the bar. You will turn shifting priorities into a plan the team can execute, and make trade-offs visible to leadership. You will own problems wherever they land, switching from a security issue to a customer call to a technical design in the same day. You will run on-call and incident response for your areas, and step in technically when the team needs it. You will work with engineers and with teams across the company to find the better approach together, and make the call when one is needed. We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to make robots autonomous. Our robots are designed to revolutionize material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods. We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer who loves debugging, stress-testing and is ready to install robots that move the world’s parcels. In this role, you’ll be the face of Flink at customer sites and industry events, making sure every system is rigorously tested, commissioned and continuously improved. Who you are Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early phase and take ownership of field projects. Passionate about robotics: from mechanics and electronics to computer vision and control. Proactive problem-solver wanting to learn new things Clear communicator, fluent in English, German, French, and other languages is a strong plus. Excited about frequent travel to production sites (up to 60 %). Enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and customers on the shop floor. What you bring Mechanical engineering background with experience designing, prototyping, and building mechanical assemblies Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues, with an understanding of mechatronics, sensors, networking and basic control principles Demonstrated track record in commissioning complex electromechanical or robotic systems in the field Excited about travel and deploying robots in production environments Prior robot deployments, proficiency in German or other languages, driver's license and familiarity with Linux are a plus What you'll do Assemble, configure and test our robots in the lab and at customer sites to iterate and improve the system Plan, coordinate and execute on-site installations, acting as the technical lead and ensuring a smooth handover to the customer Design, prototype, and produce mechanical and electrical elements for new product run deployments Train operators and provide hands-on support during ramp-up, collecting insights that feed straight back into our product roadmap Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, both remotely and on-site Why join A great team dedicated to building a product with almost unlimited potential Work on challenging problems at the cutting edge of robotics Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear Work in a central office in Zurich and around the world, wherever our partners are Apply now if you’re ready to push boundaries and help shape the future of robotics! jobs.title: Product Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web

jobs.description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. The Opportunity The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building. What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does. You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it. In this role you will Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods. Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff. Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update. Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse. Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week. Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one. What This Role Is Not You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so. Who You Are You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up. You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands. Als HR adviseur Onderwijs bij Lyceo krijg je de ruimte om inhoudelijk impact te maken én een bredere rol binnen het team te pakken. Je ondersteunt leidinggevenden, begeleidt verzuimtrajecten, verbetert HR processen en coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris. Een veelzijdige volgende stap voor een ervaren HR professional die inhoudelijk sterk is en al ervaring heeft met het begeleiden, coördineren of aansturen van collega's. Taken Als HR adviseur Onderwijs ondersteun je leidinggevenden bij personele vraagstukken, begeleid je verzuimtrajecten en denk je mee over beleid en organisatieontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd zorg je voor overzicht en samenhang binnen het team HR en Salaris. Je coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team en bent verantwoordelijk voor recruitment, waarbij je ook de recruiter begeleidt en aanstuurt. Je blijft nadrukkelijk zelf actief in de dagelijkse HR praktijk. De ene dag begeleid je een leidinggevende bij een complex verzuimdossier, de andere dag stem je prioriteiten binnen het team af, bespreek je de voortgang van recruitment of werk je aan nieuw HR beleid. Zo verbind je HR beleid, processen en de dagelijkse praktijk met elkaar. Je kent de dynamiek van de organisatie, weet wat er op de verschillende vestigingen speelt en zorgt ervoor dat het team effectief inspeelt op wat de organisatie nodig heeft. Vereisten Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Je bent een stevige HR professional die zelfstandig werkt, overzicht houdt en gemakkelijk schakelt tussen verschillende gesprekspartners. Je voelt je prettig in een rol waarin je adviseert, zaken voor elkaar krijgt en collega's begeleidt. jobs.title: wo-stage Economie & Data-analyse: onderzoek naar omzetverwachting
jobs.description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken? Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie?  Dit is jouw uitdaging Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden: Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen. Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken. Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging!  Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen? Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan? Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren?  Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen! Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: Statistiek; Python en/of R; Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers. Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. The starting salary for this role is expected to be between $155,000 and $175,000 per year. Walker Sands is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to join our DATA practice (Data, Analytics, Technology and AI) and help lead the data infrastructure behind our client reporting, measurement, internal operations, and AI-driven work. This is a hands-on role, but not a heads-down one. Reporting to the SVP, DATA, you'll lead key technical parts of our data stack and be a strategic partner on where it goes next: what to build, what to buy, what to fix, and what actually matters to the business. You don't need a lot of direction and are comfortable working through ambiguity. The role grows as you do. Near term, you'll work alongside our team and external partners to extend and strengthen the platform. Over time, you'll take on more of the technical ownership and help lead what comes next. And as the practice scales, you'll build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage. You can go deep on a broken pipeline in the morning and talk through a roadmap tradeoff in the afternoon, and you're good at both. You are a clear communicator, and work to understand needs beyond the technical with empathy and a ‘here’s what’s possible’ mindset. You find problems, fix them, document them, and explain them without making them more complicated than they need to be. 7+ years in data or analytics engineering, including time as the lead or senior technical owner on a production data platform Deep, hands-on Snowflake experience Strong dbt, advanced SQL, and working Python Experience integrating SaaS and marketing APIs (ad platforms, GA4, Salesforce, HubSpot) through ELT tools and custom pipelines A track record of shaping technical direction, not just executing tickets Clear communication with technical and non-technical people alike Strong Pluses Agency or B2B marketing data background Data governance and privacy experience (role-based access, masking, consent data) Experience making data usable for AI and LLM-driven tools Experience leading or mentoring others Comfortable using AI like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and bringing new ways of working within the data and privacy guardrails of the business What We Offer (Compensation + Benefits): Sta

jobs.description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! About the role PerfectServe is investing in a unified data platform spanning our product portfolio — the data store, the shared taxonomy, and the pipelines that will let the business answer questions across the whole platform. Our architecture team has mapped the high-level direction and target state. The detailed design is deliberately still open. This is the senior engineering seat that takes it from direction to working platform. You will shape the detailed architecture alongside our architecture team, own the implementation and integration design, and set the engineering standards the team works to — building it with a dedicated team. Why this role, specifically We have done real thinking here — the high-level direction and target state are mapped, and the business case is made and funded. What is deliberately not settled is almost everything below that line. We would rather hire someone with strong opinions about it than fill it in ourselves before you arrive. That is where the consequential decisions live — how entities resolve consistently across a broad portfolio, how time is modeled so a question about last quarter resolves against last quarter's reality, how a metric gets defined once and trusted everywhere. Cheap to get right now, expensive to correct later. So you get a direction to work from and an architecture team to partner with, plus genuine influence over both. If you would rather bring your experience to bear on a platform while it is being built than inherit one that is already set, this is that role. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. You will play a critical role in designing and building scalable data platforms and pipelines that power Socure’s identity verification products and analytics. jobs.title: Staff AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: About Standard Bots At Standard Bots, we're revolutionizing real-world automation by making robotic systems accessible to everyone. Our AI-powered platform enables robots to tackle unprecedented challenges through an intuitive instruction interface, bringing the power of software automation to physical spaces. About the Role We're seeking a Staff AI Research Engineer to develop and optimize our AI models and training systems. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your deep ML expertise to cutting-edge AI/robotics applications. You'll work closely with our engineering team to design, implement, and iterate on large-scale AI models while building efficient systems for rapid experimentation and deployment. We have a small team of AI engineers, so we’re looking for someone who is excited to work at a startup, and work across the stack to do what is needed to get a model that achieves a customer problem. We're looking for an experienced engineer ready to make a tangible impact in the AI robotics revolution. This role requires a proven background working on ML planning within the autonomous vehicle space with experience using the latest techniques in diffusion and autoregressive models in a professional setting. If you're excited about building the latest advancements in AI and working in the robotics space, we’d love to hear from you. In this role, you will: Design and implement state of the art ML models and training pipelines: Apply novel machine learning techniques to wide range of robotics applications Develop efficient data and training strategies Implement model evaluation frameworks and metrics tracking Lead model development and iteration with focus on: Rapid experimentation and prototyping of new model architectures Performance optimization and model debugging Transfer learning and fine-tuning strategies Build robust evaluation and debugging systems to: Analyze model behavior and failure modes Implement interpretability tools and visualization frameworks Track and improve model metrics Collaborate with engineering team to optimize training infrastructure and deployment You might thrive in this role if you: Have 7+ years of AI modeling experience, specifically within the self-driving car industry (or PhD with 3+ years of AI modeling experience in the self-driving car industry) Proven track record developing and deploying large-scale ML models Have experience using the latest techniques in diffusion and autoregressive models in a professional setting Are familiar with training inference and infra pipelines that go from camera input to trajectory output for self driving or robotics Have experience with RL (reinforcement learning) Have a strong understanding of modern ML architectures and training techniques Have experience with model debugging, optimization, and performance tuning Have a background in implementing ML research papers and adapting academic work Tech Stack PyTorch (experience with PyTorch required) Python NodeJS/Typescript Docker Compensation and Benefits: The salary range for this role is $250,000 to $300,000, depending on experience. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

jobs.title: AWS Data Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. This is a senior role in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters, at meaningfully lower engagement cost than traditional data consulting. Customers come to us after a data program has stalled pipelines nobody trusts, warehouses nobody runs new workloads on, a modernization that produced diagrams instead of production systems. Aedeon handles automated source discovery, schema mapping, lineage extraction, and parallel-run validation. You own what agents can't: target architecture, data model decisions, pipeline design under real constraints, and the calls that make a cutover safe. You'll build with PySpark and SQL on EMR and Glue, model for Redshift, Snowflake, Athena, and Presto, orchestrate with Airflow and your work will reach production, not a slide deck. What you will do? Build and maintain data pipelines on Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue that run in production. Design data models and end-user querying on Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. Build and maintain pipeline orchestration with Airflow. Work with customer and internal teams to understand data needs and design the solutions that meet them. Troubleshoot and optimize pipelines and data models until they hold up under real load. Write and maintain PySpark and SQL scripts to extract, transform, and load data. Document and communicate technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences — customers sign off on what we ship. Track new AWS data technologies and judge their impact on the systems we run. What are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience working with PySpark and SQL. 2+ years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue. 2+ years of experience with data modeling and end-user querying using Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. 1+ years of experience building and maintaining pipeline orchestration using Airflow. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment. You are preferred if you have AWS Data Analytics Specialty Certification Experience with Agile development methodology How we work? We run a forward-deployed model. Senior engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally fixed dates, with Mactores absorbing overage cost for delays inside our control. Aedeon absorbs scale; you absorb judgment. That means less of your week goes to inventory spreadsheets and manual validation, and more goes to architecture, data modeling, and cutover strategy. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We measure ourselves by what ships. Compensation Additional Information Life at Mactores We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent. This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers. What You'll Own Build and ship Android features using Kotlin. Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services. Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys. Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable. Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage. Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product. Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey. What We're Looking For 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin. Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps. Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture. Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows. Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues. Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality. App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage. Tech Stack Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android SDK Coroutines & Flow SQL / NoSQL TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference) The Kind of Builder We Want Thinks in user journeys, not just screens. Cares about making complex financial products feel simple. Moves fast without creating messy code. Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain. Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want fully defined tickets. Developers who build screens without caring about user experience. People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance. Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment. People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role Most LLM roles stop at experimentation. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description: Kapadi, a Humaneva Group company, is a full service CRO that focuses on complex oncology indications including immunotherapy and cellular therapies. We know that innovative research requires innovative operations and we've built that into our culture, systems and processes. We have an infrastructure to enhance access to patients and integrated technology to provide higher quality and faster access to results. We are looking for a highly-motivated Senior Project Manager to help us continue to grow our business and deliver new, life-changing therapies for the cancer patients who need them. As a Senior Project Manager, you will: Manage a project overseeing interdisciplinary clinical research studies. Act as a primary liaison between the company and the customer to ensure timely study initiation, conduct, and closeout according to the customer’s and the company’s contractual agreement, ensuring satisfaction levels are met and statuses of deliverables are communicated effectively. Lead a project team and oversee quality of clinical monitoring, timeline and site management deliverables. Be accountable for the financial performance of each assigned project. Coordinate activities and deliverables of all study conduct partners and proactively identify and manage issues. Review study and site data listings and visualizations via analytical dashboards and/or reports to identify trends, risks, and suspected scientific misconduct on other systematic errors that could impact data integrity and subject safety. Drive risk identification and risk monitoring strategy cross-functionally, ensuring that appropriate risk monitoring tactics are written into the CMP, and be accountable for the clinical team’s understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP, and risk plans. Create and maintain relevant project plans. Routinely review clinical systems, dashboards, and documentation (e.g., Site Assessment Reports) to oversee site and study team conduct and identify any risks to delivery or quality. Possibly participate in customer proposal development and bid defenses. Knowledge, skills and abilities: Demonstrated knowledge of the clinical research and development process in pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industries. Demonstrated knowledge of oncology therapeutic area. Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams of professionals, including vendor management. Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements. Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) level of qualification in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience in clinical R&D in pharmaceutical, biotechnology and/or clinical research organization (CRO) businesses, including at least 2 years of experience in a CRO providing clinical research services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device companies, and including at least 2 years of clinical management experience (i.e., oversight of CRAs). 5 years of oncology clinical or research experience preferred. Immuno-oncology and cell therapy experience also required. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About WebEngage : WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle. We are built for scale. We are built for complexity. We are built for outcomes. At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines: A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP) Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence Omnichannel journey orchestration AI-driven personalization and recommendations Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement. Learn more about us at www.webengage.com About The Role: WebEngage ’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one. Responsibilities: Pipeline Development & Reliability Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse. Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines. Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests. Data Modelling & Warehouse Design Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue. Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns. Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance. Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews. Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart). Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI). BI, Visualization & Analytics Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency. Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams. Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaboration & Communication Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage. Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place. Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more. We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you. ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely. Is this the job for you? Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going. Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there. Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets. If this sounds like you, please apply! Must haves: You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition. You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability. You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients. Nice to haves: Experience working with all-remote teams. Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible. Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on. That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you. Why work for us? Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company. Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work. Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks. A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k) Work with an awesome team for awesome causes. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives
jobs.description: At In Tandem , we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods. We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments. If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter. As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives , you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage. What you will accomplish: Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making. Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments. Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning. Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities. Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster. Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows. Who you are: A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities. A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen. A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership. Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy. Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate. What you bring: 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment. Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role. Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines. jobs.title: Manager - Data Engineering
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly motivated Manager - Data Engineering to join our growing team. This role will report to the Director of Data Engineering and will lead a team of data engineers. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with a passion for mentoring others and delivering scalable, high-quality data solutions. You will collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design and implement robust data pipelines and platforms that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives across the country and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your leadership will be critical to empowering our organization with the tools and insights needed to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes. Our Values: Put Patients First Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams Operate with Integrity & Excellence Be Innovative Work As One Team What You'll Do Lead and mentor a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence. Partner with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines and models aligned with business needs and industry best practices. Oversee the development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade ELT processes, data marts, and business intelligence assets. Own and evolve data quality frameworks, ensuring proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolution of data issues. Champion the adoption of automation and modern data engineering practices, driving efficiencies in pipeline management and data delivery. Guide your team in building domain knowledge around healthcare operations, ensuring data solutions comply with regulatory and security requirements. Contribute to strategic planning for the data engineering function, including resource allocation, technology selection, and process improvement initiatives. Support and enforce software development best practices, including code reviews, source control, CI/CD, and testing. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, engineering, healthcare, analytics, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. At least 5 years of experience in data engineering or software development roles, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or management capacity. At least 2 years of experience with medical claims in healthcare and/or managed care. Strong expertise in building scalable ELT/ETL pipelines using modern data platforms and cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure). Advanced proficiency with SQL and scripting/programming languages such as Python or Spark. Solid understanding of database structures, data modeling (normalized, star schema, snowflake), and data warehousing concepts. Experience working with Databricks or similar distributed computing platforms preferred. Familiarity with BI tools such Power BI. Deep understanding of professional software engineering practices including SDLC, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences. You're a great fit for this role if you: Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy leading teams to solve complex data challenges. Are passionate about mentoring and growing the next generation of data engineering talent. Have a bias for action and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions with measurable impact. Bring a collaborative, team-first mindset to everything you do. Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions This position is remotely based in the U.S. The total compensation target pay range for this role is: $140,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors. jobs.title: Manager - Advanced Analytics
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled and execution-focused Manager of Advanced Analytics to help shape and deliver our analytics strategy and roadmap. This role is hands-on and influential, focused on designing and implementing scalable data solutions, building advanced BI capabilities, and enabling actionable insights across risk adjustment, clinical operations, quality, compliance, and cost management. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to guide and mentor team members while collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders. You will partner with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design, implement, and optimize advanced analytics solutions that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your contributions will be critical to driving data-driven decision making and improving patient outcomes. What You'll Do Contribute to the design and execution of Astrana Health ’s enterprise analytics roadmap aligned with growth and value-based care objectives. Lead the development of scalable analytics solutions and BI dashboards using tools such as Databricks and Power BI. Implement and maintain strong data governance and development practices to ensure data accuracy, compliance, and trust. Build customized reports and dashboards tailored to functional and executive stakeholders. Partner with business units like Risk Adjustment and Quality to identify analytical opportunities, translate business needs into technical solutions, and deliver insights with measurable impact. Support standardization and optimization of reporting/analytics capabilities across teams. Mentor analysts and engineers, fostering technical excellence and a collaborative team environment. Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations while communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Promote best practices in analytics, data engineering, and BI development. Lead and mentor a team of analytics professionals supporting HEDIS quality measurement and Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) analytics. Own end-to-end execution of key deliverables: HEDIS measure calculation, gap-to-goal reporting, compliance rate optimization, and RAF accuracy analytics across multiple lines of business Partner with business stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Quality Improvement, Finance) to translate requirements into scalable analytic solutions and drive actionable insights. Establish QA protocols and ensure data integrity for all reporting deliverables. Drive improvements to Star Ratings performance and risk score accuracy through advanced analytics and process optimization. Partner with Data Engineering and IT to enhance data infrastructure, implement new measures, and resolve source data quality issues. Conduct performance reviews and set development goals, to build team strength. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data science, analytics, statistics, or related field. At least 6 years of experience in data analytics and engineering, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or mentorship role. Expertise with modern data stacks including Databricks, SQL, Azure, Power BI, and Python. Strong understanding of value-based care analytics, risk adjustment, quality analytics (HEDIS) utilization management, finance, and claims. Experience working with healthcare datasets and measures such as HCC, HEDIS, and clinical analytics. Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for clinical and operational teams. Experience in managing quality improvement initiatives and member outreach programs to close care gaps. Strong understanding of EHR, claims, and supplemental data integration for quality reporting. Hands-on experience supporting HEDIS submissions, rate optimization, or NCQA-related analytics workflows Experience in Medicare Risk Adjustment analytics, HCC/RAF gap analysis

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The opportunity You work on our most strategic accounts and turn signed deals into live, revenue-generating deployments. On our largest global rollouts, successfully embedding BLP in the customer's system landscape (e.g., ERP) decides whether the go-live date holds. As a Technical Project Manager, you own the technical solution. You shape it with the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, write the specification our engineers build from, and drive internal alignment and on-time delivery. What you'll do Shape the technical solution with the customer’s business and IT departments on large and complex accounts, and push until answers are specific enough to build on. Turn requirements into a clear, implementable specification for our engineers. Manage external and internal technical stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery and aligned priorities. Flag major development needs and blockers early, and bring a clear recommendation to the customer's steering committee. Support Project Managers on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing, through the first go-live. What you bring 3+ years in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or technical product work. A track record of delivering complex technical projects from requirements engineering to go-live. Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer. Solid understanding of how enterprise systems exchange data, from file-based interfaces to APIs. Fluent German and English, spoken and written. Nice to have Understanding of purchase-to-pay (P2P) and order-to-cash (O2C) processes, including the related finance and accounting workflows. Experience leading the technical design on multi-ERP and multi-country projects. Hands-on knowledge of several ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor), from both a functional and an integration perspective. Why BLP A fast-growing, global AI company: the ideal place to learn and accelerate your career. Ownership of the technical design on our largest, most complex customer programs. At least one month of onboarding at our Zurich headquarters. Employee ownership through our participation program. Practical information Location: our Zurich or Munich or Cologne office (hybrid with 3+ office days per week) Travel: up to 10%, mostly within DACH Employment: full-time, permanent Originally posted on Himalayas
